title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Internship Open position, Berlin Internship, 3 months Location: Berlin (hybrid) Start: January 2027, or as soon as you can Format: Full-time internship, 3 months Level: Bachelor, Master's or PhD student, or equivalent work experience Who we are. Zeitgeist Labs is the applied research institute of the future in Berlin. Founded by scientists from Stanford, MIT, Max Planck and Charité with experience at McKinsey and in previous startups. This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage company at its inflection point. Problem we solve. Governments, foundations, NGOs and universities spend trillions every year on programs meant to improve people's lives. The industry that measures whether any of it works is slow and manual: months of fieldwork, hand-coded interviews, a 300 page report that lands 2 years after the program ends. The physical sciences are being accelerated by AI co-scientists. The social sciences are not, yet. In an age of ever-increasing complexity, we are building the tools that allow researchers to tackle the hardest scientific questions of our time: how societies work, and what actually changes them. In short. You own problems end to end, working directly with the founders. Understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing. What you'll do. You work directly with the founders on the system our clients use every day. You own problems end to end: understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing. Build and improve across the whole stack, from the research dashboard to the data layer to LLM output handling, every change shipped with a test Build the architecture that turns thousands of data points, interviews, surveys and papers into insights Extend how we collect data: interview agents, surveys, document ingestion Run evals when a model or prompt changes and help decide what ships How we work. We are a human-in-the-loop AI company. Everyone here runs a fleet of agents; the human sets the direction, makes the calls and verifies the result. Claude Code is our daily driver, specs come before code, every change ships as a pull request with tests and docs. We care about creativity, critical thinking and solution orientation, not about knowing one particular framework. Who we're looking for. Self-driven: you have finished things on your own, a shipped app, a side project with users, a tool people actually use Critical thinker: you question what you read, including what an agent wrote for you, and can explain why a solution is right Wants ownership over comfort: small team, short path from your decision to the customer Bonus points if you have. Built a user-facing app in some flavour of JavaScript Written and debugged your own SQL Called, orchestrated, monitored and evaluated LLMs in something you built A solid understanding of the German language An interest in philosophy, sociology, anthropology, psychology, politics or behavioural sciences in general Why Zeitgeist Labs. Ownership of real problems from week one, and a piece of the architecture you can name on your CV Daily work with the founders, hybrid in Berlin About the interview.
